The '''Rhire Concourse of Humanity and History''' was a museum on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhire]]. On 13:9:1 [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it hosted the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" exhibit.
